name: Views Node Title Selector
description: Adds a Views exposed filter with a dropdown of existing node titles.
project_description:
Project Summary 
 This module provides a better way to filter content in Views. Instead of a basic text box, you get a smart select list or autocomplete field.

 
 Features 
 The Views Node Title Selector module adds a new Views filter that offers a user-friendly selection widget for node titles, including a select list, autocomplete field, or checkboxes. It improves usability, especially for large sites.

 Its unique feature is its context-aware behavior. It automatically detects existing "Content: Type" filters in a View and populates the title list with only relevant nodes. It also allows you to freeze the list of nodes or exclude specific ones from the filter.

 This module is ideal for creating an intuitive user interface for content filtering on administrative dashboards, making it easy to find specific content without typing.

 
 Post-Installation 
 Once you install the Views Node Title Selector module, its functionality is integrated directly into the Views UI. There is no separate configuration page. To use it, simply edit an existing View, add a new filter, and search for "Node: Title (select/autocomplete)."

 
 Navigate to Structure > Views . 
 Click Add in the "Filter criteria" section. 
 Select Node: Title (select/autocomplete) and configure its options. 
 Expose the filter to visitors, select your preferred widget type, and save the View. 
 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 This project relies on the following Drupal core modules:

 
 Node 
 Views 
 
 No other third-party libraries or APIs are required.

 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 There are no specific modules that directly enhance this project's functionality.

 
 Similar projects 
 While other modules may offer custom Views filters, this module is unique in its focus on providing a context-aware filtering experience specifically for node titles.
